NO! That is the worst idea ever if you have no idea how different class fires work. The fire extinguisher that people usually think is the ABC ones which puts out only ABC class fires which is A - Ordinary (wood, paper, plastics) B - Flammable liquids (gasoline) C - Eletrical (Computers)

If you use that on a grease fire all you will do is spread it or not even put a dent in it and can seriously injury yourself or die. If you want to get a extinguisher for it you have to buy a Class K which is used only for grease fires.
